remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Completed after August move to Texas. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. A large hill formation in the foreground, a smaller, more level one in the background. The line that defines the large formation in the foreground begins in the upper right hand corner of the paper and cuts across the composition almost completely to the other corner at the lower right.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
